column3: (X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing: on the static files Astro's node adapter serves before the middleware runs (/_a/*, favicon, manifest) and on robots.txt and sitemap.xml; every page carries nosniff (src/security/csp.ts). Pre-existing at viafrei ea91377ba and kept unchanged by the move (viafrei-web#2, no behaviour change); a follow-up, not a waiver)

(User Controllable HTML Element Attribute: informational; the scope query value is matched against the closed list of scopes and Astro escapes every attribute it writes; ZAP flags that the value is echoed, not that it is unescaped)
(Storable / Non-Storable Content: informational; the cache policy is deliberate per route (src/middleware.ts: pages private, no-cache; hashed assets immutable))
(Modern Web Application: informational; the page has islands, so ZAP suggests its Ajax spider)

(Cross-Origin-Embedder/Opener/Resource-Policy: the pages carry COOP same-origin (src/security/csp.ts); COEP and CORP are not set, and robots.txt and sitemap.xml are endpoints outside the page headers. Pre-existing at viafrei ea91377ba and kept unchanged by the move (viafrei-web#2, no behaviour change); a follow-up, not a waiver)
